title: A Ember for the Thorn Anew
author: Xanthe Hartwell
blurb: Felix Galloway, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
